listing.shortDescription: Offline compass, spoken headings, GPS altitude and lights. Optional paid Pro.
listing.fullDescription:
Find your bearing with Northlight, an offline magnetic compass for Android with optional spoken headings, GPS altitude estimates and useful light tools.

Read a heading, hear the direction your phone is facing, check an approximate altitude or open a red screen light. The core tools are free, with no ads or account.

FREE COMPASS AND SPOKEN HEADINGS
- Large magnetic compass with degrees and direction inside the dial
- Sensor accuracy feedback and figure-eight calibration guidance
- Speak one heading or enable optional automatic announcements
- Installed offline English or Romanian voices, with speed and interval controls
- Screen-reader handoff when active

OPTIONAL GPS ALTIMETER
- Altitude estimates in metres or feet
- Shows the altitude reference and reported vertical uncertainty when available
- Starts only when enabled with precise foreground location permission
- Stops when you leave the home screen or lock your phone; never restarts on its own

LIGHT TOOLS
- Camera LED lantern, with brightness control on supported phones
- Adjustable red screen light
- Repeating SOS flash signal
- Quick Settings lantern tile

OPTIONAL NORTHLIGHT PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
- Save up to eight named magnetic bearings on this device
- Open saved bearings from the home screen; follow, rename or delete them
- Optional spoken phone-turn guidance and alignment haptic feedback
- Amber and green screen lights, plus an adjustable flash strobe
- Restore ownership using the same Google Play account; no subscription

Compass, spoken headings, GPS altitude, lantern, red light and SOS stay free. Features depend on your phone's sensors, camera flash, Android settings and permissions. Your local Pro price is shown before purchase.

ON-DEVICE TOOLS
No account, ads, analytics or tracking. Camera access is requested for flash tools only; Northlight does not take photos or record video. Location is optional and used only for the altimeter. Coordinates, routes and altitude history are not saved or uploaded. No microphone or audio recording is used.

Compass and light tools work offline. Speech needs an installed offline voice; installing voices may require internet access. With a screen reader active, its own voice and privacy settings apply. GPS needs usable satellite reception. Google Play uses internet access for purchases and ownership checks. Website links open your browser only when tapped.

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
The compass shows magnetic north, not true north. Metal, magnets and cases can affect it. GPS altitude is an estimate: read its reference and uncertainty. WGS84 height is not sea level or height above ground. Spoken and saved-bearing cues describe phone orientation, not walking direction, routes, obstacles or arrival. SOS is a flashing light, not an emergency call. Northlight is not for safety-critical navigation or a substitute for emergency communications. Use flashing lights with care around people sensitive to flashes.

Privacy: https://madebykreativ.com/privacy/northlight/
Support: info@madebykreativ.com

posts.name: Launch caption for LinkedIn or Facebook
posts.text:
A clear compass. A few useful tools. No clutter.

I built Northlight for Android: an offline magnetic compass with spoken headings, optional GPS altitude estimates, an LED lantern, red screen light and SOS flashing signal.

Those core tools are free, with no ads or account. Optional one-time Pro adds saved bearings and more light controls.

Speech needs an installed offline voice. GPS needs satellite reception and precise location permission. This is a phone-orientation tool, not route navigation or emergency communications.

If you try it, I would love to know whether the heading and accuracy feedback are easy to understand.

— Andrei, Made by Kreativ

posts.name: Community post where developer promotion is permitted
posts.text:
Developer disclosure: I made Northlight, a small Android compass and light utility.

The free tools include a magnetic compass with calibration feedback, optional spoken headings, a GPS altimeter showing its reference and uncertainty, an LED lantern, red screen light and SOS flashing signal. There are no ads or account.

Optional one-time Pro adds saved magnetic bearings, spoken phone-turn guidance and extra light controls. Saved bearings are directions, not destinations; the app does not plan routes or make emergency calls.

I would appreciate feedback on the compass readability and whether the altitude uncertainty is understandable. No ratings, positive reviews or purchases requested.

posts.name: Romanian launch caption
posts.text:
O busolă clară. Câteva instrumente utile. Fără reclame.

Am creat Northlight pentru Android: busolă magnetică offline, citirea vocală a direcției, estimări ale altitudinii GPS, lanternă LED, lumină roșie pe ecran și semnal luminos SOS.

Funcțiile de bază sunt gratuite, fără cont. Pro este o achiziție opțională, unică, pentru direcții salvate și mai multe opțiuni de lumină.

Vocea trebuie să fie instalată offline, iar altimetrul are nevoie de recepție GPS și permisiune de localizare precisă. Aplicația arată orientarea telefonului; nu calculează trasee și nu contactează serviciile de urgență.

Dacă o încerci, spune-mi dacă direcția și informațiile despre precizie sunt ușor de înțeles.

outreach.text:
Hi Droid Life team,

I am Andrei, the developer of Northlight. Your contact page invites app tips, so I wanted to share a focused Android utility.

Northlight combines a free offline magnetic compass, optional spoken headings, GPS altitude estimates and light tools. The 1.2.0 release adds a larger dial, speech and an altimeter that displays the altitude reference and reported uncertainty. No ads or account. Optional one-time Pro adds saved bearings and extra light tools.

A useful demonstration would be how a compass heading differs from route navigation, and why an altitude reading needs an uncertainty label. The app does not plan routes or call emergency services.

If this fits your app coverage, I would welcome an independent look. No favourable review or placement is expected.

Thanks,
Andrei
Made by Kreativ
